summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted after experiencing persistent abdominal pain and increased discharge from her G-tube following an incident where she stepped on the tube. Initial evaluation raised concern for possible dislodgement or perforation, so she was kept NPO and underwent a G-tube sinogram, which confirmed the tube was correctly positioned with no evidence of leakage. She was restarted on tube feeds, which she tolerated well, and her skin erythema improved with proper wound care. Pain was managed with medication, and she remained stable throughout the admission. She was discharged home with instructions for ongoing wound care, medication management, and follow-up with surgery clinic for possible tube repositioning.
